intent: What currently deserves attention, not what has already shipped.

lanes.title: Make the public site follow source authority
lanes.summary: Close the three-intent Website v3 navigation release before moving the approved source-governed research refresh into public production.
lanes.work: Reconcile security advisories, stale architecture contracts, exact publication permissions and release QA; keep unfinished branches out of What Changed.
lanes.closureCriterion: W0 is merged only after required gates pass, the production revision is verified, and candidate research copy has completed separate owner/editorial review.

lanes.title: Compare abstraction-preservation tests against native mathematics
lanes.summary: The finite quotient and transition verifier is internally exercised. General statements about knowledge, cross-domain applicability and novelty remain research questions.
lanes.work: Run matched controls and counterexamples for stochastic/approximate cases, then preserve failures and 'no added value' results.
lanes.closureCriterion: A repeatable matched-baseline packet reports success, failure and novelty boundaries without converting finite controls into a universal theory.

lanes.title: Test a candidate executor against bounded instrument contracts
lanes.summary: The Boundary Executor is a proposed interface for witnesses and lawful continuation checks, not a completed general-purpose machine.
lanes.work: Identify the smallest implementable typed reference kernel, compare with existing narrow instruments and define falsifiable validation obligations.
lanes.closureCriterion: A scoped implementation and independent tests exist, or a recorded counterexample narrows or rejects the candidate design.
